input.command:
python3 -c 'exec("""import os
import duckdb
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)
values = duckdb.sql("""SELECT year(crash_date) AS year, SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed) AS pedestrians_killed FROM read_parquet(\x27data/crashes.parquet\x27) WHERE crash_date >= DATE \x272013-01-01\x27 AND crash_date < DATE \x272026-01-01\x27 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year""").df()
values["year"] = values["year"].astype(int)
values["pedestrians_killed"] = values["pedestrians_killed"].astype(int)
years = values["year"].tolist()
counts = values["pedestrians_killed"].tolist()
plt.rcParams.update({"font.size": 10, "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5), layout="constrained")
bars = ax.bar(years, counts, color="#2878B5", width=0.72)
ax.bar_label(bars, padding=3, fontsize=8)
ax.set(title="Pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes, 2013–2025", xlabel="Crash year", ylabel="Pedestrians killed")
ax.set_xticks(years, rotation=45)
ax.set_ylim(0, max(counts) * 1.17)
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
fig.savefig("out/option_1.png", dpi=180)
plt.close(fig)
values.to_csv("out/values_1.csv", index=False)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5), layout="constrained")
ax.plot(years, counts, color="#C44E52", marker="o", linewidth=2)
for year, count in zip(years, counts):
    ax.annotate(str(count), (year, count), xytext=(0, 8), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set(title="Pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes, 2013–2025", xlabel="Crash year", ylabel="Pedestrians killed")
ax.set_xticks(years, rotation=45)
ax.set_ylim(0, max(counts) * 1.17)
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
fig.savefig("out/option_2.png", dpi=180)
plt.close(fig)
values.to_csv("out/values_2.csv", index=False)
print(values.to_string(index=False))
""")'
